correctness.rationale: The four coefficient equation families are obtained by direct expansion over dual numbers; nonzero square-zero 2-by-2 matrices have shared nilpotent line. Over the elementary Jordan nilpotent, direct linear algebra yields B-fiber ranks 2m-r+1 for odd characteristic and 2m for characteristic two. Irreducibility and pairwise noncontainment of odd-characteristic support strata give 2^m components; proper incidence over the nilpotent-line projective conic gives exactly two components in characteristic two. Dimension, motivic and point-count formulas are consequences of disjoint stratification. The standalone finite-field checker constructs the defining equations independently and passes 15 rank-fiber configurations and 2 complete dual-number enumerations, including genuine F4; finite checks are corroboration, not the proof. No statement about unreduced jet structure is accepted.

originality.rationale: The assertion is a complete all-arity first-jet geometric and arithmetic classification, not the known irreducibility of reduced base-field nilpotent tuples. Full-text comparisons show the nearest jet papers treat either unrestricted commuting pairs or reduced nilpotent orbit closures. value.rationale: The natural invariant concerns infinitesimal deformations of representations of a commutative square-zero-generator algebra, a setting where base-scheme nonreducedness materially affects jet geometry. Exact classification for all tuple lengths and all characteristics reveals a 2^m-to-two component jump, proves an equidimensionality threshold and supplies complete point and motivic counts; the structural mechanism explains how zero constant coordinates acquire scalar tangent directions. This is broader than a standalone small numerical count and does not assume a downstream theorem.
